no-restricted-globals.name: Date
no-restricted-globals.message: The engine must be deterministic. Callers filter by availableFrom.

no-restricted-globals.name: performance
no-restricted-globals.message: The engine must be deterministic. performance.now() is a clock. Callers filter by availableFrom.

no-restricted-globals.name: process
no-restricted-globals.message: The engine must be pure. Reading process.env or process.hrtime makes the same input produce different output.

no-restricted-globals.name: crypto
no-restricted-globals.message: The engine must be deterministic. crypto.randomUUID/getRandomValues are randomness; all randomness lives in apps/harness with a committed seed.

no-restricted-globals.name: globalThis
no-restricted-globals.message: globalThis re-exposes every banned global (globalThis.Date.now(), globalThis.Math.random()). Name what you need directly so the other rules can see it.

no-restricted-properties.message: All randomness lives in apps/harness with a committed seed.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Dynamic import() bypasses no-restricted-imports. The engine is pure and imports nothing at runtime.
